description: Build PlayerProfilePreview modal component. Display player stats, recent games, follow/unfollow, block actions. Triggered by clicking player avatars across page.
steps: Create components/games-hub/player-profile-preview.js: modal component that fetches GET /api/players/:user_id/profile + GET /api/players/:user_id/stats on open
Display: profile pic, name, sports played, total games, win rate, current streak, recent results (3-4 games), badges
Follow button: if not followed POST /api/social/follow, update button to 'Unfollow'; if followed POST /api/social/unfollow, update to 'Follow'
Block button: show confirmation dialog, POST /api/social/block/:user_id
Loading state: skeleton loaders for stats fields
Error state: 'Profile unavailable' message (e.g., if user blocked or private profile)
Add avatar click handlers: leaderboard player names, game cards 'Players You Know', recent results MVP
Modal responsive: slides up on mobile, centers on desktop
acceptance_criteria: Click player avatar opens profile modal
Profile displays correct stats: games, wins, win rate, streak
Recent games list shows last 3-4 matches
Follow button works: POST /api/social/follow, updates to 'Unfollow'
Unfollow button works: POST /api/social/unfollow, updates to 'Follow'
Block POST succeeds, toast shows 'User blocked'
Blocked user cannot view profile (404 or 'Private profile')
verification: Click player name in leaderboard, modal opens
Verify profile displays correct stats for that player
Button updates to 'Unfollow', click it, verify POST /api/social/unfollow called
Click 'Block', confirm dialog appears, accept, verify POST /api/social/block called
Test blocked user: login as different user, try to view blocked user's profile, verify error
Resize to mobile, verify modal slides up from bottom
Test profile unavailable: mock GET /api/players/:id/profile to 404, verify 'Profile unavailable' message
